[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Alexandr Wang megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DesignArena (@DesignArena); megjelent: 2026-11-09T18:05:55+00:00; link: https://x.com/DesignArena/status/2119854010387873914; média: videó, 11 másodperc]
BREAKING: Muse Ember by @AIatMeta has redefined the Preference vs Speed Pareto frontier on Overall HTML, knocking out 10 top models from @GoogleDeepMind, @OpenAI, and @DeepSeek_ai.

At 33s per generation, Muse Ember is 9.5× faster on average than the previous Pareto frontier models. It is also at least 34× cheaper on average than all the previous Pareto frontier models it replaced at $0.10/$0.50 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.004 cache). It is also ranked 10th overall with an Elo of 1345!

A huge congrats to the @AIatMeta team on a top-10 placement on the leaderboard!
